name: Wide-Field Camera
flavor: Captures broad-context panoramic optical images of planetary bodies.

name: High-Res Imager
flavor: Long focal length telescope delivering detailed surface images.
inspiredBy: HiRISE on Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter and LROC NAC

name: Thermal IR Imager
flavor: Measures surface infrared emission to reveal temperatures and heat signatures.
inspiredBy: Landsat TIRS and Diviner on LRO

name: Spectrometer
flavor: Analyzes reflected sunlight spectra to identify mineral composition.
inspiredBy: CRISM on MRO and Moon Mineralogy Mapper (M3)

name: Radar Sounder
flavor: Sees below the surface using radio waves.
inspiredBy: Radar sounders flown on lunar and martian orbiters

name: Neutron Detector
flavor: Detects epithermal neutrons to map hydrogen and subsurface water ice.
inspiredBy: LEND on LRO and Lunar Prospector neutron spectrometer

name: Laser Altimeter
flavor: Fires precision laser pulses to create high-resolution elevation maps.
inspiredBy: LOLA on LRO and MOLA on Mars Global Surveyor

name: Magnetometer
flavor: Measures localized crustal magnetic fields and solar wind interactions.
